Fish encyclopedia data sources

Bundled public species names, scientific names, classification and water types:
National Institute of Fisheries Science (국립수산과학원), Species Information API
https://www.nifs.go.kr/openApi/actionOpenapiInfoList.do
The catalog includes its collection date and source. No API credentials or
account-owned records are included in the distributed catalog.

Taxon identifiers, scientific-name validation and language links:
Wikidata contributors (structured data is available under CC0)
https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing

Korean introductory descriptions, where an exact matching article exists:
Korean Wikipedia contributors, Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
https://ko.wikipedia.org/
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
The corresponding article source link is retained with cached descriptions
for a separately displayed attribution interface.

Representative photographs, where a reusable matching file is available:
Wikimedia Commons. The original file's author, source page and license link
are retained in metadata for separate attribution. Individual file licenses apply. Images with
unverified or noncommercial-only permissions are not selected.
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:Reusing_content_outside_Wikimedia
Images are displayed with their original aspect ratio and without cropping.

Additional actual photographic files reviewed on 2026-11-05:
Decapterus maruadsi: re_nebel, CC BY 4.0
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Decapterus_maruadsi.jpg
Planiliza haematocheilus: Jung-Goo MYOUNG, CC BY 3.0
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Planiliza_haematocheilus.png
Acanthopsetta nadeshnyi: Voronina, Elena P.; Volkova, Galina A., CC BY 4.0
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Acanthopsetta_nadeshnyi.png
The latter is an original plate with an actual type specimen photograph
and a radiograph, retained complete without cropping or reconstructing the fish.
These subject/license-reviewed files fill gaps even when structured taxon
image links are missing. Explicit illustrations, paintings, maps and generated
art identified in filenames or metadata are excluded from photo selection.

Supplemental photographs from verified active species taxa:
iNaturalist contributors. Only individual CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0, or CC BY-SA 4.0
photos are selected. Author, original photo page, license and taxon identity
are checked and retained in cached metadata for separate attribution.
https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices
https://help.inaturalist.org/en/support/solutions/articles/151000169918

Accepted scientific-name relationships:
GBIF Species API v2 using the current Catalogue of Life XR checklist,
checklist UUID 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b.
Both names are checked at species rank. A synonym does not override a
conflicting Korean name or authorize photos from another taxon.
https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi/v1/species

Bundled Korean translations/summaries of English Wikipedia contributors' text,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0. The text is translated and abridged;
these are not original Korean Wikipedia articles. Reviewed 2026-11-05 against
the following revisions, whose scientific-name and taxon links were checked:
Slender giant moray (Strophidon sathete), revision 1370178422
https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Slender_giant_moray&oldid=1370178422
Scomberoides tol, revision 1363314457
https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Scomberoides_tol&oldid=1363314457
Hypsagonus corniger, revision 1271719228
https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Hypsagonus_corniger&oldid=1271719228
Yellowfin sole (Limanda aspera), revision 1351305262
https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Yellowfin_sole&oldid=1351305262
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Optional Korean morphology/ecology descriptions:
National Marine Biodiversity Institute of Korea (국립해양생물자원관), MBRIS
https://www.data.go.kr/data/15094770/openapi.do
Description source and attribution metadata are retained for separate display.
Uses the authenticated public OpenAPI only when the developer configures it.
Verified public descriptions are also included in assets/data/fish_enrichment.json.
The official portal's reuse scope was checked on 2026-11-06 as unrestricted
(이용허락범위 제한 없음). API credentials and collector reports are not bundled.

Additional bundled public descriptions and photographs reviewed 2026-11-06:
Individual source pages, photo authors and license URLs accompany each result
in assets/data/fish_enrichment.json; content is merged only for exact catalog
identity. Selected Korean Wiki descriptions/habitats are abridged Korean
summaries, under CC BY-SA 4.0. The original authors/contributors, source page,
adaptation notice and license link are retained per species. This includes
Korean Wikipedia and the Global World Encyclopedia / Korean Wikisource
contributors. The latter's exact matching 붕어 and 잉어 sections use revision
317006 of 글로벌 세계 대백과사전/생물I·동물·인체/동물의 분류/척 추 동 물/어류 경골어류.
https://ko.wikisource.org/
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
These summaries do not override catalog taxonomy or assert rights in the
original underlying photographs. Individual photo licenses continue to apply.

Two additional actual photographs downloaded and visually reviewed:
Acanthopagrus schlegelii: Rakurakuda, CC BY-SA 4.0
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:クロダイ.jpg
Paralichthys olivaceus: User:Vmenkov, CC BY-SA 3.0
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Paralichthys-olivaceus-Federal-Way-3583.jpg
Other new species-linked photographs use iNaturalist taxon photographs with
matching species identity and individual author, original photo page and
CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA license metadata retained in the bundled public data.

Whole-catalog collection, 2026-11-06:
All 800 catalog identities were processed against the public source lanes.
The selected output includes 588 Korean descriptions and 420 photographs;
source-specific results overlap. English Wikipedia was also used to locate
species-matched photographs, without redistributing English article prose.
MBRIS domestic/foreign distribution fields supplement its descriptions.
Independently sourced body-length excerpts retain their original source and
license in sizeProvenance even when another source supplies the main prose.
docs/fish_enrichment_inventory.json records the complete public inventory.

Additional official photographic source, reviewed 2026-11-06:
National Institute of Fisheries Science (국립수산과학원), KOGL Type 1
(attribution; commercial use and modification allowed as stated by each
species dialog's own license badge):
https://www.nifs.go.kr/contents/actionContentsCons0088.do
Official reuse policy:
https://www.nifs.go.kr/contents/actionContentsCons0001.do
Only exact Korean/scientific-name pairs with the individual Type 1 badge and
an official representative photographic file are collected. Institutional
attribution, source page, policy link and original watermarked photo URL are
retained. No publication year or individual photographer is invented when
the source does not provide one. There are 33 matching licensed source photos,
including 11 additions to previously missing photos (431 final photo links).

The previous NARIS adapter is retained for possible future use and is not
called by the default encyclopedia service. The NARIS API information page
displays KOGL Type 3 (attribution; no derivatives):
https://naris.science.go.kr/intd/sym/selectOpenApiIntroduce.do
